entities.name: RlmN
observations: The 382-residue query sequence matches reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa RlmN proteins at 89.5% identity with approximately 100% coverage and E-values near 1e-251.
RlmN is a dual-specificity radical SAM RNA methyltransferase that methylates adenine N2 at position 2503 of 23S rRNA and position 37 of tRNAs.
RlmN binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).
